question: Can static experimental discrimination be tested?
evidence: P/V/spot and transition-inclusive metallographic labels are public for 60 bundles and 38 unique conditions per alloy
main_caveat: Small repeated design; label mismatch; constant LS; strong domain shift
minimum_next_action: Run per-alloy grouped OOF h versus generic 2D process baseline

question: Can a finite-pool experimental AL replay be executed?
evidence: Four 20-point full-map pools A/B and C/D are public; public code documents power-block policy; derived feature pickles and exact path logs are absent
main_caveat: Published optical-label query order is not guaranteed bit-exact; only 20 conditions and three power levels per pool
minimum_next_action: First reconstruct and hash the four metallographic 20-point pools; replay only after Level A gate

question: Can bare h be checked within each material?
evidence: P and VX are available and the verified constant 1/e^2 radius is 25 um
main_caveat: Within this dataset h is only a rescaled P/sqrt(VX); LS exponent and universal threshold are untestable
minimum_next_action: Evaluate Ti64 and 316L separately with SI h and train-only calibration

question: Can a material-normalized cross-alloy coordinate be checked?
evidence: Gan Eq. 1 and supplementary constants cover Ti64 and SS316; external P/V/T0/r0 are available
main_caveat: Absorptivity is not measured for these builds; SS316 constants are not exact 316L batch constants; phase/temperature choices matter
minimum_next_action: Predeclare a Gan-constant sensitivity analysis and propagate parameter uncertainty; do not fit constants to labels

question: Is the external resource worth a focused validation study?
evidence: Independent physical labels, same Ti64 family, second alloy, public process map and raw signals
main_caveat: External data can test transfer but cannot exactly replicate the simulator label or spot-size dependence
minimum_next_action: Implement Level A only as the next experiment
